system.description:
Reflex Amp

Your Sharingan grants you the following bonuses;

Chakra Sight. You gain 30-Feet of Chakra Sight.

Enemy Reading. You gain a rank of mastery to the following skill-based action; See Through Lies, Sense Motive, and Search. You can also use the aforementioned skill-actions as a bonus action.

Eye of Insight. When you take the Read the Enemy skill action, you gain a +4 bonus to the check.
system.summary: 30-foot Chakra Sight. Mastery on See Through Lies, Sense Motive and Search (as bonus actions), and +4 to Read the Enemy.

rules.text: At initiative it lasts until combat ends; as a Bonus action, 1 minute.
